name: Game Icon: Dragon Koban & Blade
purpose: Primary App Icon Candidate B: Direct 'Samurai + Money' Theme.
description: A traditional oval Japanese gold Koban wealth coin cleaved diagonally by a crimson-edged katana silhouette inside a blood sun ring.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D vector game app icon representing samurai wealth. A traditional Japanese oval gold Koban coin silhouette with stamped crimson seals, cleaved diagonally by a sleek near-black samurai katana sword with a sharp glowing crimson blade. (Framed by a giant perfectly smooth solid crimson circular solar ring:1.4). Pure pitch-black background, pristine vector geometry, razor-sharp clean edges, flat graphic icon, bold symbolism, no 3D, no soft painting, no gradients, no text, no pixelation, no noise.
